map_description: Visit LAKUM Artspace in the heart of Riyadh
faq_hours_a: We're open Sunday - Thursday from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM, and Friday - Saturday from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
faq_location_a: We're located at Al Urubah Branch Rd, Umm Al Hamam Al Gharbi, Riyadh 12328, Saudi Arabia.
faq_booking_q: How do I book a venue?
faq_booking_a: You can contact us directly via phone, email, or fill out the contact form with your venue rental inquiry.
faq_exhibition_q: How can I exhibit my work?
faq_exhibition_a: Please reach out to us with details about your work and exhibition concept. We review all proposals and will get back to you.
faq_workshop_a: Yes! We offer various workshops and seminars. Check our calendar or contact us for current offerings.
faq_collaboration_a: Absolutely! We love collaborating with artists, organizations, and creative professionals. Let's talk!
thank_you_message: We appreciate your interest in LAKUM Artspace. We'll review your message and get back to you as soon as possible.

success_message: Thank you for contacting us. We'll be in touch shortly.
